objective: Qualify Haze4K scene grouping, local baseline-error measurement, bounded oracle headroom, proxy learnability, and only then a trainable spatial restoration module without exposing confirmation outcomes during development.

haze4k_train_data_integrity.core_assumption: Haze4K train can be paired and grouped by original clear scene without accessing the official test split.
haze4k_train_data_integrity.close_condition: Close if the frozen loader-compatible pairing and canonical clear-scene grouping cannot establish a leakage-free train and internal-development split.

haze4k_baseline_local_error.core_assumption: Fixed official ConvIR-B predictions on Haze4K train development scenes contain stable local restoration errors measurable at clear-scene level.
haze4k_baseline_local_error.close_condition: Close if local error prevalence, direction, or scene-level stability fails the frozen measurement gates.

haze4k_local_action_oracle.core_assumption: A bounded non-deployable keep, weaken, or strengthen action oracle has material scene-level headroom over uniform adjustment.
haze4k_local_action_oracle.close_condition: Close if bounded spatial actions do not improve the frozen primary estimand while satisfying the tail-harm gates.

haze4k_local_action_proxy.core_assumption: Input or intermediate features can predict bounded local restoration actions or harm risk under scene-grouped cross-validation.
haze4k_local_action_proxy.close_condition: Close if grouped out-of-fold prediction fails the frozen utility and calibration gates against shuffled and spatially uniform controls.

bounded_spatial_restoration_module.core_assumption: A learnable network-internal bounded spatial regulator can exploit qualified local state and risk signals beyond parameter-matched spatially uniform controls.
bounded_spatial_restoration_module.close_condition: Close if fair module variants cannot improve scene-level restoration quality without violating frozen total and intervention-added harm limits.

haze4k_candidate_confirmation.core_assumption: A completely frozen candidate can improve the candidate-unseen Haze4K official test relative to the official baseline after baseline-only metric reproduction.
haze4k_candidate_confirmation.close_condition: Close after the single frozen candidate confirmation use, regardless of PASS, INCONCLUSIVE, or FAIL.

nh_haze_external_validation.core_assumption: A Haze4K-confirmed frozen candidate retains directionally consistent utility and bounded tail harm on previously untouched NH-HAZE images.
nh_haze_external_validation.close_condition: Close after the single sealed NH-HAZE evaluation, regardless of terminal decision.
